description: Publish a one-on-one session using the full LPBE session editor payload. Requires confirm set to PUBLISH. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

amount.description: Price amount in the business currency.

availability.description: Weekly hours when the session can be booked.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation for this write. Pass the exact literal this tool requires (for example DELETE) only after the user approves the action.

coverMediaItems.description: Cover images or videos for the product.

createdBy.description: User ID of the business manager creating the session.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD.

hostInfo.description: Host details shown to members who book the session.

location.description: Where the session takes place (online link or address details).

minimumNoticeInDaysForBooking.description: Minimum number of days of notice required before a booking.

sessionId.description: One-to-one session product ID, from a Nas.com product listing.

status.description: Status value; use one of the allowed values in this schema.

tieredPrices.description: Price tiers to save for the business.

timezoneChosenForAvailability.description: IANA time zone that the availability hours are written in.

unAvailableDates.description: Dates when the session cannot be booked.

name: publish_session
title: Publish Session
